summary: Fall Hollow: RoverPass claimed listing, operator lodging page (headless browser past Cloudflare), Google, gateways, Esri read. Year-round; 30/50 A FHU and a W/E site; operator $35-45 vs RoverPass $40-50 (both under the gate); 42 numbered RV sites; request-to-book on RoverPass; monthly $700 offered. Electric raised 30 -> 50.
flags: PRICE GATE: pass - cheapest RV night $35 (operator, W/E) / $40 (RoverPass); full hookup $45 operator / $50 RoverPass. Not needed, but no gateway within 40 km. Google 4.0 (216).
RATE CONFLICT: the park's own page posts $35/$45/$45, RoverPass (its booking channel) $40/$50/$50; both recorded in the fee note, range 35-50.
ELECTRIC 30 -> 50: the stored 30 came from the old note; the operator lists '50amp water, electric, sewer & Wi-Fi site (22 sites available ...)'.
SITE COUNT: RoverPass says 42 and numbers sites 1-42; the operator's page adds up to 36 (1 W/E + 13 30 A FHU + 22 50 A FHU). 42 written.
LONG-STAY: $700 monthly offered Jan-Jul on RoverPass; imagery shows a modest number of rigs spread over open loops, no sheds or decks - reads as a mostly nightly park. Tests pass.

WATERFRONT LEAD (not changed): RoverPass tags 'Waterfront'; the operator puts only three tent 'beach area' sites on Big Swan Creek. The outer RV loop runs along the creek's wooded bank (e.g. ~35.5785,-87.4290), with a continuous tree line between; no RV site is named on the water. Stays not waterfront.
